requirements.evidence: 3-cell L base (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full + piece:0,1,0;full) each with hex-bin-full-div2 (6 compartments total) for separating threads, needles, buttons, etc. Staged with spool-like props (tape-electrical, solder-reel) representing thread spools.

finish.summary: Built a compact 3-cell L-shaped organizer with three divided bins (6 compartments) to sort sewing supplies. End caps and joint locks applied, props added to illustrate thread/spool storage.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
